title: Customer Assurance Concierge and Auto-Classifier for Security Requests
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit security and compliance requests via email, vendor questionnaires, and support tickets. Current handling is manual, inconsistent SLAs, and duplicated effort across sales, account teams, and security. Goal: build a lightweight "concierge" intake service + auto-classifier that standardizes incoming asks (SOC2/ISO, HIPAA, GDPR/DPA, vendor questionnaires), assigns a priority tier, bundles required evidence, and surfaces a recommended SLA and owner. This reduces manual routing time, improves SLA transparency, and scales the compliance team without increasing headcount.

Solution overview:
- Intake API + UI: single intake endpoint used by support, sales, account teams, and self-serve form. Stores original artifact (PDF/CSV/Drive link) and extracts text via OCR pipeline.
- Auto-classifier: a small, explainable LLM-based classifier that maps a request to: request_type (SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor-questionnaire), severity (none/low/medium/high), and resource needs (evidence types, legal review). Classifier returns confidence and top-3 rationale snippets.
- SLA calculator: deterministic rules + historical signals (customer tier, regional regs, document complexity) yield suggested SLA lanes (48h, 5d, 14d).
- Concierge bundler: template-driven evidence pack generator that compiles common artifacts (SOC2 cert, IP allowlist, encryption diagram). Produces shareable bundles and a minimal cover letter template for customers.
- Integrations: Confluence/Drive for evidence storage, GitHub PR links for remediation tasks, Zendesk/Intercom for ticket crosslinking, internal security backlog ingestion.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Intake form + API accept file uploads and links, store canonical artifact, and queue for OCR with >95% success on sample doc set.
2) Classifier accuracy >= 88% on held-out labeled dataset (balanced across request types) and confidence score present for triage decisions.
3) SLA calculator returns consistent lanes and a human-overrides flag.
4) Concierge generates evidence bundles with templated placeholders and links to source artifacts.
5) End-to-end prototype routes 10 sample customer requests automatically to an owner with recommended SLA and evidence bundle.

Metrics to track: mean time to first-route, percent auto-routed, classifier precision/recall per class, evidence-bundle completion time, customer satisfaction (CSAT) for security ask handling.

Trade-offs and notes:
- We will prioritize explainability over raw classifier accuracy to preserve trust with legal/security reviewers. Rationale snippets and confidence make it reviewable.
- Keep model footprint small (low-cost hosted classifier or on Dedicated infra) to avoid creating a new runtime dependency.
- Start with supported ask types limited to SOC2/ISO/HIPAA/GDPR/DPA/vendor questionnaires and expand later.
- Evidence bundler will initially rely on a curated mapping of common document types to templates; long-term we can attempt fuzzy matching to surface candidate artifacts.

Rollout plan:
Phase 1 (MVP): internal intake form + classifier prototype, evidence templates for SOC2/GDPR, routing to security queue (Q2 2026).
Phase 2: integrate with Zendesk and external customer-facing portal; add HIPAA/DPA templates and automated cover letters (Q3 2026).
Phase 3: expand to vendor questionnaires (auto-mapping of questionnaire sections to evidence) and SLA automation with alerts (Q4 2026).
